title: Nvidia joins Crusoe's $1.375B Series E

sources.quote: Share: Mubadala Capital and Valor Equity Partners co-lead funding to scale Crusoe’s vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform SAN FRANCISCO and DENVER – October 24 – Crusoe, the AI factory company, today announced the initial closing of its anticipated $1.375 billion Series E round, bringing the company's expected valuation to over $10 billion.

explain: Nvidia was among the participants in Crusoe's $1.375 billion Series E, which valued Crusoe at over $10 billion. Nvidia's own amount was not disclosed.
